mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agency_audit_application WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId}
mapper.sql: CASE ag.audit_status WHEN 0 THEN '未审核' WHEN 1 THEN '待审核' WHEN 2 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 3 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知' END
mapper.select: SELECT app.id, app.agency_full_name, app.audit_status, CASE app.audit_status WHEN 0 THEN '未审核' WHEN 1 THEN '待审核' WHEN 2 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 3 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知' END AS audit_status_text FROM agency_audit_application app LEFT JOIN agency ag ON app.agency_id = ag.id ORDER BY app.id DESC
